extraction_notes: Sector poll of Arab society in Israel only (title: ממצאי סקר בחירות בחברה הערבית), dated 05.09.2026. Fieldwork 27-8-2026 15:30 to 1-9-2026 14:51. Mixed method: 482 phone + 333 internet = 815 respondents; 'גודל מדגם התחלתי' printed as 800 (smaller than actual respondents 815). Phone: 2080 answered, response rate 23% of valid; internet panel sent to 5020, response 7% - no single overall response rate, so response_rate_pct=null. All tables are labelled 'אחוזים גולמיים' (raw), so weighted=false; seats are fractional Arab-sector contributions and do not sum to 120 (sums ~18.3-18.6). Text dump is empty; all values read from images.
